messages:
carmen: FYI spotted a persistent aggregation gap in today's daily rollup (~2.3% undercount). seems related to partial ETL retries and missing span joins. tagging infra/data owners to align on owners and timeline.
lee: ack. saw a short consumer stall at 04:17 UTC that coincides with the rollup window. log snippet: ```2026-04-02T04:17:03Z WARN consumer: heartbeat timeout, pausing partitions [2,9]```
hana: that pause will reorder session keys; aggregator expects deterministic ordering so joins can miss. rough impact estimate 2-3% for last 24h.
evan: short-term I can add a consumer-lag alert (threshold: 5m) + a targeted reingest helper that pulls compacted segments for affected partitions. ETA for alert+script: 2026-04-03 12:00 UTC.
priya: i'll own data validation and customer impact list. validation steps: 1) replay rollup for 04:00-05:00 with fixed offsets, 2) diff key hit rates, 3) check billing totals and top affected tenants. ETA notebook: 2026-04-03 EOD.
ops-bot: incident-created: "aggregation-gap-detection" severity: P3. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aggregation-gaps
carmen: proposed owners: evan -> alert + reingest tooling (ETA 2026-04-03), priya -> validation + impacted list (ETA 2026-04-03), lee -> coordinate backfill windows and compute estimate (ETA 2026-04-04), hana -> implement ingest_sequence + reorder-tolerant dedupe behind FF (ETA 2026-04-06).
lee: i'll estimate compute and schedule small targeted replays first; we should avoid a full replay unless delta >1%.
evan: implementation note: reingest helper will be idempotent and scoped by partition-time; can run dry-run to show expected deltas.
priya: also recommend a postmortem action: create a recurrence dashboard that shows daily rollup delta vs shadow replay and a histogram of join misses. want a 6-week follow-up cadence to track regressions.
carmen: agreed. adding action items to the postmortem doc at https://redwood.internal/postmortems/aggregation-gap-2026-04. i'll ping support with the impacted-customer list once priya posts it.
ops-bot: reminder: please record owner assignments in the runbook checklist.
lee: action recap in thread: evan -> alert+reingest (2026-04-03), priya -> validation+customer list (2026-04-03), lee -> backfill coordination (2026-04-04), hana -> ingest_sequence+FF (2026-04-06), carmen -> postmortem tracking (ongoing). flag blockers here. :eyes:
